notes.title: Patch #5
notes.notes: [p]Hey Friends,[/p][p][/p][p]We're back with another update! The main focus is on a new game end, with a new island you can keep constructing on. We've also added a bunch of Quality of Life improvements amongst a range of fixes.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Developed a game end, with animations and a new island you can continue building on.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new goal to develop Capital to Level 8.[/p][/*][*][p]After reaching Capital Level 3, a new tutorial has been implemented to guide players on what to do with tools produced by settlements that need to be transported to other production sites in order to upgrade them.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Depot tutorial explanation with new text and a video.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more Hotkeys to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some resource area upgrade requirements to be less confusing to players.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Depot Panel to notify players when a train arrives or departs..[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Signal logic - Enable 'Trigger on train tail' parameter for newly created actions related to the station signals[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Station Condition panel to make it clearer and more intuitive to interact with.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the 'Wool' icon to prevent confusion with 'Clothing' resource.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio - Game audio will no longer mute when tabbing out, or focusing on a different window.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked price formation to fix negative price for Flour and Fish for the Level 7 town.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated factory models and added decoration to the town.[/p][/*][*][p]Signal logic - When using “Less Than” in station conditions, train checks for free space/goods now properly register if the train has at least 1 slot/item.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Andriy and Curve Trains 🚂 [/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes: [p]Hello Engineers,[/p][p]We're delighted to be delivering our fourth Hotfix to the game. Please see the notes below.[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased the world size.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a frame limit setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the save system The new system now allows saves to custom slots, backup saves & restoration from backup files.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "save as" functionality to pause menu, so player can now save without exiting the game. Players can either:[/p][list][*][p]Save gameplay to currently used save slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Save gameplay to any empty save slot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Each slot can now hold 2 saves. One manual, and one auto save (created if played for 10+ mins). [/p][list][*][p]Players can then keep the automatic save by moving it into an available save slot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Load save file function to pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would allow you to give multiple trains the same name. If you now try to put in a name that is already in use it reverts back to one of the default random names.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug whereby regions overlapped (Town and Flour).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug whereby removing a single train name (from name condition) also removed other train names as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug whereby if a refuel post was built near station signal, it removed existing signal logic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when after a station was destroyed, signals nearby were still controlled by the destroyed station.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep your feedback coming![/p][p]Andriy and Curve Trains 🚂 [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Engineers,[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]I'm delighted to confirm that today Super Loco World receives its third Hotfix, addressing feedback you've shared on Discord and in your reviews. [/p][p] [/p][p]Here's what's in the latest Hotfix:[/p][list][*][p]Added inverted logic for goods related conditions. Players can now set goods-related conditions using both "More than X" and the newly added "Less than X" logic, allowing for more precise control[/p][/*][*][p]Depos have also been upgraded with dual stop signs for each direction, improving ease of use[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused trains to freeze during flour station upgrades[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep your feedback coming, we're working hard behind the scenes to address more feedback and suggestions. Stay tuned![/p][p] [/p][p]-Andriy[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes: [p]Hey Engineers,[/p][p]We're back again! Thank you for all of the feedback you've provided to us so far, its really helpful to ensure we can be reactive with our updates. Read on for a breakdown of our latest Hotfix...[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug when it was impossible to build a station in an overcrowded region (happened with super loco region)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Depo UI including color selection. Added tiny smoke animations for all depo interactions with a train[/p][/*][*][p]Let player type a custom name for a train in a depo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Here are also some short-term plans we’re working to deliver in the near future:[/b] [/p][list][*][p] A tool for emergency train evacuation to the depot (for a small fee)[/p][/*][*][p]Inverted logic for goods-related conditions. Currently, it only supports "More than X" — we plan to add an option for "Less than X"[/p][/*][*][p]Display somewhere a tip with a list of wagons and the goods they are carrying[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to save to a different slot[/p][/*][*][p]More settings: framerate limit, windowed mode[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial improvements — specifically, new buildings and mechanics will be unlocked as you progress[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More updates are on the way, so stay tuned![/p][p]Curve Trains 🚂 [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Super Loco World is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello friends,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm thrilled to announce that today my game [b]Super Loco World[/b] is officially launching as part of the Steam Automation Fest![/p][p]This is a very important and exciting moment for me — you never know how the audience will react to your game. Maybe everything will go well and I'll continue making indie games, or maybe I’ll have to get a “real job” (haha). But regardless, I’m proud of what we achieved with our tiny team (core team of 2). And while it might sound cliché, this is truly my dream game. I had this idea for a long time, and it’s exactly the kind of trains game I was always missing.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes since the Demo[/h3][p]I admit that Super Loco World Demo wasn’t perfect. But we gathered and carefully analyzed all your feedback to fix problematic parts of the game. So let me share what was changed in the full game compared to the demo.[/p][p]The main issue almost everyone pointed out was the tutorial. So we completely overhauled it — now it includes video guidance and is split into separate step-by-step lessons to help you better understand basic gameplay concepts. We also added contextual hints about how to automate railway signals.[/p][p]Another big change was reworking one of the demo’s core mechanics — island creation. It sounded good on paper, but in practice it added unnecessary complexity and made late-game logistics clunky once you had multiple islands. So in the full game, you’ll play on one large island. And instead of creating new islands, a new and more elegant mechanic has been introduced: [b]you choose where to found a town and where to place production regions.[/b] Of course, there are some restrictions — for example, lumber mills can only be placed near forests, and the fishing industry must be created near the ocean.[/p][p]On top of that, we made numerous small UI improvements, fixed most of the bugs and annoyances we could find, and even improved the graphics a bit. I’m sure you’ll notice and appreciate all these changes in the full release.[/p][p][/p][h3]Post launch plans[/h3][p]We’re planning at least one major update after launch that will include everything we wanted to add on release but didn’t have time for. More specifically:[/p][list][*][p][b]Accessibility improvements[/b], including key rebinding and updated save system[/p][/*][*][p][b]Difficulty settings[/b], allowing both easy mode (e.g. transparent trains or infinite money) and harder game mode where you’ll have to count every coin[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smaller improvements[/b], like being able to take a loan when funds are low, and a display showing your current economy status[/p][/*][/list][p]I also see great potential in extending the game with additional objectives, gameplay scenarios, or even entirely new game modes. But I don’t want to promise anything just yet — first, I want to make sure you have interest in continuing to play Super Loco World after the main campaign is completed.[/p][p][/p][h3]Finally[/h3][p]Thank you for all your support and feedback! I’d also like to invite you to our cozy [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/XAQPuBT2uq"]Discord server[/url][/u], where you can share your thoughts about the game and show off what you’ve built (I seriously can’t wait to see it!).[/p][p]So, if you’re into logistics games, automation, or just appreciate unique and unusual games — go get [b]Super Loco World[/b]![/p][p]- Andriy[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.7.8
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Engineers! 
[/p][p]Firstly, we want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has played our demo! Your feedback and suggestions are incredibly valuable as we work to refine Super Loco World ahead of its launch. 
 
We recognize there are elements of our tutorial/instruction elements that could use some improvements, and we’re actively implementing additional guidance in the demo and for the final game. Your feedback is crucial, so please keep it coming! 
[/p][p]Here's a quick overview of what we’ve addresses so far, and we’re just getting started! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/5ea305e04cc26cb07a6dd428f610f5a1fdb817f6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]DEMO FIXES - V0.7.7![/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]T[/b]utorial improvements[/p][/*][*][p][b]R[/b]ail signal UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p][b]A[/b]dded missing escape functionality to UI prompts[/p][/*][*][p][b]I[/b]mproved train UI[/p][/*][*][p][b]N[/b]ewly added manual override to traffic lights[/p][/*][*][p][b]S[/b]ubstantially increased train interaction zone for depots[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]DEMO FIXES - V0.7.8![/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]S[/b]mall rephrasing adjustments in tutorials [/p][/*][*][p][b]T[/b]rash icon added when erasing items to avoid it being mistaken for a close button [/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b]xtended the demo with an additional island and extra goal to level up your town to level 4 [/p][/*][*][p][b]A[/b]dded correct Discord link [/p][/*][*][p][b]M[/b]oving camera now possible with keyboard in the first tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/5ea305e04cc26cb07a6dd428f610f5a1fdb817f6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being a part of this journey with us, together we’re building something we think is special, [b]Super[/b] even!  [/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist and follow us here on Steam to stay up to date with all things Super Loco World! 
[/p][p]Curve Trains 🚂 [/p]

notes.title: Next Stop, Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Engineers! [/p][p][/p][p]Look, it’s our first piece of news – that’s exciting! First of all, thank you so much for taking the time to check out Super Loco World, it means a lot to us. Secondly, welcome! It’s an absolute pleasure to have you all aboard, and we hope you enjoy the journey ahead. We’ve got some exciting news to share as part of our first message...[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/5ea305e04cc26cb07a6dd428f610f5a1fdb817f6.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]DEMO AVAILABLE NOW AND NEXT FEST ON MONDAY![/b] [/h3][p]We’re happy to announce [b]we’ve just launched a Demo version of Super Loco World that you can play right now![/b] Check the link below to start playing.[/p][p]Furthermore, we’re going to be in Next Fest! We know there’s always a huge selection of games to choose from during the event, so if you do have the time to check out Super Loco World, we’d be incredibly grateful.[/p][p]It’s a unique passion project, made primarily by Andriy Bychkovskyi with the help of a small team, including: Vitalii Hyhorash - a talented 3D artist who is responsible for the gorgeous graphics, Serhii Tronchuk – A fantastic sound designer who implemented the mind-pleasing SFX, Danylo Dunets – the mastermind behind the relaxing soundtrack and finally Roman Yanchyshyn – a programmer who helped with shaders and post effects to give the game those finishing touches.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]In the Demo version of the game, you’ll be able to access all functionalities, including:[/b][/i] [/p][list][*][p]Track construction[/p][/*][*][p]Train controls, track controls[/p][/*][*][p]Goods delivery[/p][/*][*][p]Island creation[/p][/*][*][p]Rail signals automatization[/p][/*][*][p]Trains refuelling 
[/p][/*][/list][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/6c87c1f8be3045c3f5a417a21b9a08047cae2aa9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/9d8389b3046c4adcf45addf7969aea3073929e3c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/ed4c3a45eba08b73a42417c2c3c02bceccfeb915.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/0ca7c6d99d6d7c489ea07b0786c84ad4f9fa2910.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/5ea305e04cc26cb07a6dd428f610f5a1fdb817f6.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]A LITTLE BIT ABOUT SUPER LOCO WORLD[/b] [/h3][p]So, what is [i]Super Loco World?[/i] Well, let us start by saying it isn’t your average train game. It’s a relaxed, yet surprisingly strategic experience where building, automating and optimizing your rail empire is at the forefront of this cozy adventure. [/p][list][*][p][b]Effortless Building -[/b] Lay down tracks with ease using intuitive tools that feel like painting on an island canvas, making it easy to redesign and improve your routes as your cozy empire expands. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Smart Automation - [/b]Set up smart rail signals, logic-based stop signs, and dynamic junctions to keep your fleet flowing. You know what they say. [i]“The more you automate, the more you... your... deliveries... won’t be late?”.[/i] That’s good enough, right? [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]An Evolving World -[/b] No two games are the same thanks to procedurally generated maps and economies. Villages grow and demand increases, so make sure your network keeps up with your ambitious expansion. [/p][/*][/list][p][i]Super Loco World's[/i] relaxing pace, soothing music and effortless construction belie an in-game economy that will test even the shrewdest businessperson and automation savvy industrialist.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/5ea305e04cc26cb07a6dd428f610f5a1fdb817f6.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]DEV DIARY WITH ANDRIY BYCHKOVSKYI[/b][/h3][p]Check Out the Dev Dairy below to delve behind the scenes and find out what inspired him to create the ultimate cosy, automated train experience.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5c3Xb4GFXhI;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149208/5ea305e04cc26cb07a6dd428f610f5a1fdb817f6.png"][/img][/h3][p]Remember, if you like the look of the game hit that Wishlist button, it really helps us out![/p][p] [/p][p]Curve Trains 🚂 [/p]
